title: Initial leftward scan
statement: Let $w$ be a Boolean word, let $p$ be an input-head position for $w$, let $d$ be any data tape, let $\ell$ be an integer, and let $m$ be a nonnegative integer. For every integer $j$ with $0\le j<m$, start the cleaner in state $0$ with its data tape $d$, its marker tape true exactly on $[\ell,\ell+m)$, its origin marker at $0$, and all heads at $\ell+j$. After exactly $j+2$ steps, it is in state $1$ with the same data, interval marker, and origin marker, and all heads at $\ell$.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is an arbitrary tape of optional Boolean symbols
replaced:
Let $d$ be a data tape and let an interval of width $m$ start at $\ell$. For every $j <
m$, running the interval cleaner for exactly $j + 2$ steps from its initial state with
all heads at $\ell + j$ reaches its rightward-erasure state with all heads at $\ell$,
independently of blank holes in $d$.
